segments.name: Healthcare services
segments.description: Delivers inpatient and ambulatory healthcare to patients through an integrated network of hospitals, clinics and physician practices.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, which is healthcare services.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by delivering care to patients through its integrated network of hospitals, ambulatory facilities, and physician practices.
revenueModel.evidence: The healthcare services segment generates revenues by delivering care to its customers, or patients, through its integrated network of hospitals, ambulatory facilities, and physician practices.

changes.text: In 2024, the company converted from a Delaware limited liability company into a Delaware corporation in connection with its initial public offering.
changes.evidence: On July 17, 2024, Ardent Health Partners, LLC converted from a Delaware limited liability company into a Delaware corporation in connection with its initial public offering and changed its name to Ardent Health Partners, Inc.

changes.text: In 2025, the company changed its name from Ardent Health Partners, Inc. to Ardent Health, Inc.
changes.evidence: On June 3, 2025, Ardent Health Partners, Inc. changed its name to Ardent Health, Inc.
